title: Nvidia’s $14 Billion Hugging Face Deal Looms But Does It Make Sense?
title_zh: Nvidia 140 亿美元的拥抱交易即将到来，但这有意义吗？
summary: Nvidia is reportedly nearing a deal to buy AI platform Hugging Face for about $14 billion. It could be a long-term boost for the stock.
summary_zh: 据报道，英伟达即将达成协议，以约 140 亿美元收购人工智能平台 Hugging Face。这可能会对该股产生长期提振。

title: Microsoft Signed a 20-Year AI Power Deal With Chevron. Is Power Becoming the New Chip Shortage?
title_zh: 微软与雪佛龙签署了为期 20 年的人工智能电力协议。功耗会成为新的芯片短缺吗？
summary: Microsoft’s next major AI constraint may be measured in turbines rather than processors.
summary_zh: 微软的下一个主要人工智能约束可能是用涡轮机而不是处理器来衡量的。

title: Nvidia-Backed Anthropic Inks $35 Billion Deal. Just Don’t Call It ‘Circular Financing’
title_zh: Nvidia 支持的 Anthropic 签署了 350 亿美元的交易。只是不要称之为“循环融资”
summary: Nvidia stock was edging down early Tuesday as investors assess its role in the latest AI cloud-computing deal with Anthropic.
summary_zh: 周二早些时候，随着投资者评估英伟达在与 Anthropic 的最新人工智能云计算交易中的作用，英伟达股价小幅下跌。

title: ONEOK to Grow Midland Midstream Footprint with Brazos Acquisition
title_zh: ONEOK 通过收购 Brazos 扩大米德兰中游业务
summary: ONEOK signed an agreement to buy Brazos Midstream's natural gas gathering and processing assets in the Permian Basin for around $4.425 billion in cash, enabled by a new $9 billion minority equity investment from Apollo.
summary_zh: ONEOK 签署协议，以约 44.25 亿美元现金收购 Brazos Midstream 在二叠纪盆地的天然气收集和加工资产，阿波罗公司新提供了 90 亿美元少数股权投资。

title: This 4.5%-Yielding Pipeline Stock Just Made a $4.4 Billion Acquisition. Here's What It Means for the Dividend.
title_zh: 这家收益率为 4.5% 的管道股票刚刚完成了 44 亿美元的收购。这对股息意味着什么。
summary: Oneok is making a major acquisition and strengthening its financial profile.
summary_zh: Oneok 正在进行一项重大收购并增强其财务状况。
